battle.name: 韓戰
battle.brief: 一九五〇年六月二十五日北韓越過三八線攻南，聯合國軍退守釜山，仁川登陸後反攻，年底中國志願軍入朝，戰線推回三八線。韓戰是近代最後一場步兵在山脊上密集對射的戰爭；卡面這支一八四〇年法軍雷管步槍正是加蘭德步槍的技術祖型：雷管點火、米涅膛線、全金屬彈殼，一路演成那八發子彈的彈夾。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰方在名義上分三層。北方是朝鮮民主主義人民共和國：執政的朝鮮勞動黨以金日成為最高統帥，軍隊稱朝鮮人民軍，六月二十五日以兩個成軍師越過三八線，另有由南方游擊隊改編而成的游擊支隊在山區配合，戰後大批游擊隊員被正式編入軍籍。東面是中華人民共和國派遣的中國人民志願軍：一九五〇年十月底首批渡過鴨綠江，志願軍司令部由彭德懷任司令員兼政治委員，前線部隊編為第三十八、第三十九、第四十、第四十二、第五十、第六十六縱隊軍等，兵力自一九五〇年底至一九五一年春迅速增至數十萬。聯合國方面是一支多國部隊：美軍第八軍團長期指揮東線，美軍第十軍團在西線，英國、加拿大、紐西蘭、荷蘭、比利時、哥倫比亞、埃塞俄比亞、菲律賓、南非、土耳其、希臘等國先後派地面部隊參戰，戰事高峰時共有十六國投入作戰，南韓陸軍則是整個戰役的地面主力之一，另有各國海空軍在南朝鮮與黃海作戰。中蘇並未以交戰國身分上陣，但蘇聯以空軍作戰與大量軍火實物供應支援前線。
countriesEn: The belligerents fell into three nominal layers. In the north was the Korean Democratic People's Republic: the ruling Korean Workers' Party took its orders from Kim Il Sung, and the armed forces, called the Korean People's Army, crossed the 38th parallel on 25 June with two divisions already formed and supported in the mountains by guerrilla bands recruited from the guerrillas who had operated in the South, many of whom were later formally enlisted into the regular army. To the east was the Chinese People's Volunteer Army, sent by the People's Republic of China: the first contingents crossed the Yalu in late October 1950, and the Volunteer Army Headquarters, with Peng Dehuai as both commander and political commissar, directed the front-line units, which were organised into the 38th, 39th, 40th, 42nd, 50th and 66th Army Groups, with the numbers on the ground swelling from tens of thousands to several hundred thousand between the end of 1950 and the spring of 1951. On the United Nations side stood a multi-national force: the US Eighth Army commanded the eastern front for most of the war and the US X Corps the western, while ground troops came from the United Kingdom, Canada, New Zealand, the Netherlands, Belgium, Colombia, Ethiopia, the Philippines, South Africa, Turkey and Greece, with sixteen nations taking part at the peak of the fighting; the Republic of Korea Army was one of the principal land contingents of the whole campaign, and the various navies and air forces operated over South Korea and the Yellow Sea. Neither China nor the Soviet Union fought as a declared belligerent, but Moscow supplied air power and large quantities of military materiel in kind.
people: 關鍵人物可分三條線。第一條是美方決策線：總統杜魯門先後簽署對南韓與盟國的援助，遠東軍總司令麥克阿瑟主張速戰速決，把戰線一路推到鴨綠江與中朝邊界；一九五〇年九月十五日他在威克島與杜魯門、國務卿艾奇森會商後拍板仁川登陸，其後兩人在戰爭範圍上分裂，杜魯門於一九五一年四月解除麥克阿瑟兵權。戰場指揮層更迭頻繁：第八軍團司令沃爾頓·沃克一九五〇年十二月在韓境車禍身亡，由馬修·里奇韋接任；第十軍團與海軍陸戰隊第一師由埃德溫·艾爾蒙德轄下諾曼·史密斯率領，第九師團第七騎兵營的「攻擊營」是最先抵達長津湖的美軍部隊；停戰協議由聯合國軍參謀長克拉克代表簽字。第二條是北方與中國：金日成坐鎮平壤，朝鮮人民軍參謀總長金策策劃攻勢；志願軍入朝後由彭德懷統一指揮，林彪、鄧華分任第十三兵團與第十五兵團指揮員，洪學智、宋時輪在東線與東海岸方向作戰。第三條是南韓與前線基層：總統李承晚主持國政，各師師長輪番死守防區，一九五〇年十一月的「史密斯特遣隊」以不足千人對抗一個整師，最後傷亡過半，長津湖的費思上尉率數百人守在公路樑上斷後。
peopleEn: Three lines of decision-makers matter here. The first is the American command chain: President Truman authorised aid to Seoul and to the allies, while Far East Commander Douglas MacArthur pressed for a quick decision and for the front to be carried to the Yalu and the Sino-Korean border; on 15 September 1950 he met Truman and Secretary of State Dean Acheson at Wake Island and won approval for the landing at Inchon. The two men then split over how far the war should be carried, and Truman relieved MacArthur of his command in April 1951. Field command turned over rapidly: Eighth Army's Walton Walker was killed in a vehicle accident in Korea in December 1950 and was succeeded by Matthew Ridgway; X Corps and the 1st Marine Division were under Edwin Almond and Norman Smith, and the 9th Division's 7th Cavalry Attack Battalion was the first American formation to reach the Chosin Reservoir; the armistice was signed for the United Nations Command by its chief of staff, Mark Clark. The second line is the North and China: Kim Il Sung ran the war from Pyongyang with Kim Chaek, the army chief of staff, planning the offensives, and after the Chinese entered the war Peng Dehuai held unified command, with Lin Biao and Deng Hua commanding the 13th and 15th Army Groups, and Hong Xuezhi and Song Shilun fighting on the eastern front and along the east coast. The third line is the South Korean army and the front-line soldiers: President Syngman Rhee governed the state while division commanders rotated in a lethal game of holding ground, and Task Force Smith, fewer than a thousand strong, took on a full enemy division in November 1950 and lost more than half of its strength, while Captain Don Faith held the road bridge with several hundred men as the rear guard at the Chosin.
kits: 本卡兵器是法軍一八四〇年制式雷管步槍（fusil modèle 1840），口徑約十三點七毫米，銅製底火配雷管點火，前裝定裝彈；同一支系在一八四〇年代末至一八五〇年代改用米涅彈，配合膛線與配合式彈頭後有效射程大幅提高，線列步兵的火力密度因此改觀。雷管一路演進到一八五六式米涅步槍、一八八六年勒貝爾步槍的全金屬彈殼與手拉槓，最後落到韓戰戰場上三種主力步槍：美軍M1加蘭德步槍、蘇製莫辛—納甘特M一八九一／三〇式，以及日造三八年式的少量殘存。實戰射程方面，加蘭德有效射程約五百公尺，八發彈匣；志願軍與朝鮮人民軍的莫辛為五發彈匣，射速每分鐘約十至十二發。機槍以美軍勃朗寧M一九一九A四式七點六二毫米機槍、M二式十二點七毫米重機槍為主，志願軍以DP—28輕機槍與五〇式衝鋒槍為主，另有繳獲的莫辛式輕機槍。砲兵與裝甲：美軍配六〇與八一迫擊砲、一〇五及一五五毫米榴彈砲、三英寸反戰車砲，以謝爾曼四一A三E八與M二六「潘興」九〇毫米砲對抗T—三四／八五、IS—二、SU—七六自走砲；志願軍配一二二、一五二毫米榴彈砲與四十五毫米反戰車砲，蘇聯供應的砲彈令其在某些地段形成炮兵密度優勢。各式卡車、吉普與戰車決定了山區補給線的長短，而雷管步槍真正的直系後代，是加蘭德步槍上那個射空後會發出清脆一響的鋼製彈夾。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the French Model 1840 percussion rifle (fusil modèle 1840), of about 13.7 mm calibre, fired by a copper percussion cap and loaded from the muzzle with a paper cartridge; the same family switched to the Minié ball in the late 1840s and 1850s, and with the rifling and the expanding bullet plug the effective range rose sharply, which transformed the density of fire of line infantry. The percussion principle then travelled through the Minié rifle of 1856 and the all-metal case and bolt of the 1886 Lebel, and finally reached the Korean battlefield in the shape of three main service rifles: the US M1 Garand, the Soviet Mosin-Nagant Model 1891/30, and a small residue of Japanese Type 38 Arisakas. In practice the Garand had an effective range of about 500 metres and an eight-round clip, while the Mosin held five rounds and fired at roughly ten to twelve rounds a minute. Machine guns were the Browning M1919A4 in 7.62 mm and the M2 Browning in .50 calibre on the United Nations side, and the DP-28 light machine gun and the Type 50 submachine gun on the Chinese and North Korean side, together with captured Mosin light machine guns. Artillery and armour: the Americans fielded 60 mm and 81 mm mortars, 105 mm and 155 mm howitzers and 3-inch anti-tank guns, meeting T-34/85s, IS-2s and SU-76 self-propelled guns with M4A3E8 Shermans and the 90 mm gun of the M26 Pershing; the Chinese had 122 mm and 152 mm howitzers and 45 mm anti-tank guns, and Soviet-supplied shells let them build up an advantage in artillery density in some sectors. Trucks, jeeps and fighting vehicles decided the length of the mountain supply lines, and the true lineal descendant of the percussion rifle is the steel clip in the Garand that rings out when the last round is fired.
tactics: 一九五〇年夏的北韓戰法接近近代步兵戰的典型樣貌：步兵以營縱隊成密集縱隊前進，在坦克與少量機槍支援下正面突擊，兩翼沿山脊平行推進，晝夜兼行而補給不足，攻勢銳氣難以持久。志願軍一九五〇年冬季的戰術截然不同：夜間以小分隊滲透插入敵線，剪斷退路與道路，天亮再以縱隊連續衝擊，把一條連續防線打成無數孤立的據點；美軍在清川江一線的崩潰正出於此。一九五一年起聯合國軍轉入防禦：前沿由數百個互相支援的坑道與射擊陣地構成，牢牢佔領山脊線，後方設反斜面射擊陣地，火力按「射擊地域」劃分，由各級砲兵指揮統一調度；反擊前先集中數十門、一百餘門砲行十分鐘至十五分鐘的準備射擊，步兵隨後在坦克與極少量直升機掩護下突進。空地協同是制勝關鍵：夜間以B二九與B二六轟炸北方鐵路樑與公路橋，長期執行「炸橋」戰役，切斷由東北向前線的補給；海軍在北韓沿岸布雷封鎖，掩護海岸線並封鎖北方港市。補給上，釜山港與釜山—大邱鐵路是聯合國軍的生命線，戰線穩定後前線距離縮到數百公里；志願軍則靠人拉、馬車與人海頂住漫長的縱深。
tacticsEn: The North Korean way of fighting in the summer of 1950 resembled the standard pattern of modern infantry war: battalions advanced in dense columns, pressing straight ahead with tanks and a few machine guns in support, the flanks moving along the ridges in parallel, marching by day and bivouacking at night, and the momentum of the offensive could not be sustained for want of supply. The Chinese tactics of the winter of 1950 were the opposite: small groups filtered forward at night, slipped through the enemy line, cut the roads and the retreat routes, and at dawn the columns charged in successive waves, breaking a continuous front into a scatter of isolated strongpoints; the collapse of the Americans in the Chongchon River sector came from exactly this. From 1951 the United Nations Command fought on the defensive: the front line was made of hundreds of mutually supporting trenches and firing positions astride the ridge lines, with reverse-slope positions dug in behind, and fire power allocated by fire support area under the control of the artillery chain at every level. Before a counter-attack, dozens or a hundred or more guns were massed for a ten-to-fifteen minute preparatory barrage, after which infantry attacked under cover of tanks and a very few helicopters. Coordination between air and ground was decisive: B-29s and B-26s struck railway bridges and road spans at night in the long-running bridge-busting campaign, cutting the lines of supply running from the north-east to the front, and the navy mined the North Korean coast, sealing the shoreline and closing the northern ports. On logistics, the port of Pusan and the Pusan-Taegu railway were the lifeline of the United Nations Command, and once the front stabilised the distance to the fighting shrank to a few hundred kilometres; the Chinese, by contrast, kept a very long depth and held it with human labour, carts and sheer numbers.
data: 兵力對比上，開戰時朝鮮人民軍可用部隊約六個師、逾十萬人，坦克一百五十輛以上，飛機多為蘇制舊式戰鬥機；同期美軍在韓境地面部隊約一萬五千人，南韓陸軍約四萬八千人。戰役節奏：釜山防線自一九五〇年八月撐到九月，北韓軍最遠推進至洛東江邊，距釜山不足一百公里；九月十五日仁川登陸，投入兵力逾七萬人、登陸艇七百餘艘，攻方在灘頭付出數百人的傷亡。全戰自一九五〇年六月二十五日至一九五三年七月二十七日，計三年零一個月。各方作戰陣亡（不含平民）的官方與研究估計：聯合國軍各國加總約三萬七千至四萬人，志願軍約六萬至九萬人，朝鮮人民軍約二萬五千至五萬人，南韓軍方公布約三萬七千人。裝備輸入方面，志願軍在戰爭期間自蘇聯取得步槍逾十萬支、機槍數千挺、戰車數百輛、飛機數百架與大量砲彈；中國空軍雖未參戰，志願軍仍配得蘇制米格十五，與美軍F八六野馬在「米格走廊」空戰，美軍官方記錄空對空擊落十四架米格十五、代價是一架野馬，中方則宣稱擊落數百架美軍機。停戰線全長約二百四十公里，協定由十八個條款構成，簽字者為金日成、彭德懷與克拉克。
dataEn: On numbers: at the opening of the war the Korean People's Army could field about six divisions and upwards of a hundred thousand men, with more than 150 tanks and an air force mostly of ageing Soviet types; at the same moment the United States had roughly 15,000 ground troops in Korea and the Republic of Korea Army about 48,000. The rhythm of the campaign: the Pusan perimeter held from August to September 1950, and the North Korean army came closest at the Naktong River, less than 100 kilometres from Pusan; the landing at Inchon on 15 September put more than 70,000 men ashore in over 700 landing craft, and the attackers paid several hundred casualties on the beaches. The whole war ran from 25 June 1950 to 27 July 1953, three years and one month. Military dead, as officially recorded and estimated in the literature and excluding civilians: between 37,000 and 40,000 for the United Nations forces of all nations, 60,000 to 90,000 for the Chinese Volunteers, 25,000 to 50,000 for the Korean People's Army, and about 37,000 as announced by the South Korean military. In terms of deliveries, the Chinese drew from the Soviet Union over 100,000 rifles, several thousand machine guns, several hundred tanks, several hundred aircraft and very large quantities of artillery ammunition; though the Chinese air force never entered the war, the Volunteers were equipped with Soviet MiG-15s, which fought the US F-86 Sabres in the air battles over what came to be called MiG Alley, where the American official record credits fourteen MiG-15s destroyed for the loss of one Sabre, while Chinese claims put American aircraft losses in the hundreds. The armistice line runs about 240 kilometres in length, the agreement is drawn up in eighteen articles, and the signatories were Kim Il Sung, Peng Dehuai and Mark Clark.
cause: 戰爭的根在二戰後的朝鮮半島分治。一九四五至四八年間美蘇以三八線劃界，北方由蘇聯支持的朝鮮勞動黨、南方由美國扶植的李承晚政權對立；聯合國一九四七年的分治決議並未阻止雙方各自建軍建國，一九四八年南北兩個共和國先後成立，北方的軍隊以滲透南方游擊隊為主，並在蘇軍逐步北撤後加速擴張。北方開戰有三層推力：制度上要建立全朝鮮的單一領導；經濟上，一九四七年起的第一個五年計劃把重工業與煤鐵產能集中在北部山區，漢城以南缺乏工業基礎；軍事上蘇軍自一九四八年逐步北撤，一九五〇年中期北邊集結約二十萬兵力，開戰前已儲備大量兵員、坦克與砲彈。外在環境是美國為節省兵力，一九四九年將第八軍團兩個師調回國內，只留小規模駐軍；南韓軍隊裝備殘缺、訓練不足，經濟持續惡化。北方的判斷是南方未經大戰、美國不會為了韓國與蘇聯直接交戰；一九五〇年六月二十五日拂曉，朝鮮人民軍越過三八線大規模進攻。
causeEn: The roots of the war lie in the post-war partition of the Korean peninsula. Between 1945 and 1948 the United States and the Soviet Union drew a line at the 38th parallel, with a Soviet-backed Korean Workers' Party in the north and a United States-backed Syngman Rhee government in the south; the United Nations partition resolution of 1947 did not stop each side from raising an army and founding a state, and in 1948 two republics were established, the northern army growing out of guerrilla penetration into the South and expanding faster once the Soviet troops began to withdraw. Three pushes lay behind the northern decision to fight: the regime's drive for a single leadership over all Korea; the economy, since the First Five-Year Plan launched in 1947 concentrated heavy industry and coal and iron capacity in the northern mountains, leaving the country south of Seoul without an industrial base; and the military situation, with Soviet forces withdrawing north from 1948 and some 200,000 troops massed on the northern border by mid-1950, backed by stocks of men, tanks and shells before the war began. The external conditions were that the United States, to economise on manpower, brought two Eighth Army divisions home in 1949 and kept only a small garrison, while the South Korean army was short of equipment and training and the economy kept deteriorating. The North's calculation was that the South had not fought a real war and that the United States would not go to war with the Soviet Union over Korea; at first light on 25 June 1950 the Korean People's Army crossed the 38th parallel in force.
impact: 韓戰把冷戰的前沿釘在東亞，改寫了兩個大國的用兵方式。對美國而言，這是一場「有限戰爭」的示範：既要守住盟國，又不與蘇聯直接交火，結果是人海加火力的消耗拉鋸；一九五〇年代美國的戰略因此在歐洲依靠核威懾，在亞洲則維持龐大的常規部隊與前沿部署，並發展出以常備軍而非核武為主的「大規模報復」概念。對中國而言，戰爭確立了解放軍的現代化作戰路徑與亞洲軍事信譽，也加深了中蘇之間的裂痕：志願軍的實戰經驗與大批蘇式裝備輸入中國軍隊，蘇聯卻在六十年代初回撤顧問與技術援助。對日本而言，佔領結束後即被編入美軍遠東體系，放棄戰爭憲法第九條的解釋被推翻，防衛政策與經濟在五十年代重新定性。對半島而言，停戰線把國家分成兩個武裝對峙的政權，漢城以北數百公里成了世界軍備密度最高的邊界之一，雙方常備兵力長期維持在百萬量級；而與德國分治不同，這條前線線段是冷戰中唯一未以新一場戰爭重新劃定的一條。
impactEn: The Korean War nailed the Cold War front to East Asia and rewrote how the two great powers fought. For the United States it was a demonstration of limited war: holding an ally without a direct clash with the Soviet Union, at the price of an attritional war of men and firepower; American strategy in the 1950s therefore rested on nuclear deterrence in Europe and on very large conventional forces deployed forward in Asia, and on a doctrine of massive retaliation built on conventional armies rather than on nuclear weapons. For China the war confirmed the modernisation of the People's Liberation Army's way of fighting and established Beijing's military reputation in Asia, while deepening the Sino-Soviet rift: the field experience of the Volunteers and great quantities of Soviet equipment flowed into the Chinese army, and Moscow in turn withdrew advisers and technical assistance in the early 1960s. For Japan, brought into the American Far East system as soon as the occupation ended, the interpretation of Article Nine of the constitution was overturned, and defence policy and the economy were redefined in the 1950s. For the peninsula, the armistice line divided the country into two armed states, and the hundreds of kilometres north of Seoul became one of the most heavily militarised frontiers in the world, with both sides keeping standing armies in the million range; and unlike the partition of Germany, this stretch of front line is the one piece of the Cold War that was never redrawn by a new war.
result: 停戰協議於一九五三年七月二十七日在板門簽訂，交戰方在當晚十時前全面停止敵對行動，前線大致回到三八線附近，隨後由雙方軍事分界線與非軍事區隔開。結果的兩面很清楚：志願軍以相對有限的邊境部隊投入換來北方工業區的完整控制，並在聯合國軍面前展示了夜間滲透與縱隊連續衝擊的可行性，令西方重新估算亞洲常備軍的規模與亞洲國家的動員能力；聯合國軍則保住了南韓、收復漢城與漢江流域，戰術上趨於成熟，卻始終未能消滅北方政權，也沒有任何一支部隊推進到三八線以北並建立新的國家。戰俘交換先後分批進行，雙方回返被俘人員，多數南北士兵回到原屬陣營。停火之後，兩個朝鮮仍以百萬量級的常備軍隔線對峙，軍備競賽、滲透與危機延續至今未曾中斷；韓戰是五個安理會常任理事國中唯一以停戰而非和平協議收場的戰爭，留下一份仍然生效的停戰安排、一個始終沒有建立起來的和平機制，以及一段從未正式宣告結束的戰爭。
resultEn: The armistice was signed at Panmunjom on 27 July 1953, and all hostile action was halted before ten o'clock that evening; the front settled broadly back near the 38th parallel, later divided by the Military Demarcation Line and the Demilitarized Zone. The result has two clear sides. The Chinese Volunteers, committed from a relatively small force on the frontier, won control of the northern industrial belt intact and demonstrated before the United Nations army the feasibility of night infiltration and successive column charges, forcing the West to reassess both the size of Asian conscript armies and the mobilisation capacity of Asian states. The United Nations Command saved South Korea, retook Seoul and the Han River valley and grew tactically mature, but never destroyed the northern regime, and no formation ever pushed north of the 38th parallel to found a new state. Prisoners were exchanged in several batches, each side returning its captives, and the large majority of North and South Korean soldiers went home to the army they had served in. After the firing stopped, the two Koreas still faced each other across the line with standing armies in the millions, and the arms race, infiltration and crises have continued without interruption up to the present; the Korean War is the only war in which all five permanent members of the Security Council ended in an armistice rather than a peace treaty, leaving a ceasefire that is still formally in force, a peace machinery that was never built, and a war that has never been formally declared over.
